description: Santa Fe, NM – In a unanimous and bipartisan vote, the House Commerce and Economic Development Committee advanced House Bill 10, the RLD Cannabis Enforcement Act, marking a significant step in strengthening regulatory oversight in New Mexico’s cannabis industry.   Sponsored by Rep. title: HB10 Receives Unanimous Do Pass From Commerce Committee — Doreen Ybarra Gallegos - NM State Representative District 52
